title: CLAUDE.md becomes a pointer to AGENTS.md — the inlined never-miss digest leaves; check-governed-prose reads the pointer form
body:
Maintainer direct instruction to the skills seat (session `session_01MoTv7pn338AZ71owsp19gQ`, GitHub `os-justin`), given in that PM session's chat on 2026-09-09 at 13:3xZ and 13:4xZ, verbatim, untranslated:

> 「看一下 hotcrm 的agents.md 写的太乱了。只留下必要的。包括同时同时审核 hotcrm 的skills 任务，合并派发处理。」

> 「首先要明确 hotcrm 是元数据应用，平台功能应该在 objectstack中开发。 其次 claude.md 是不是直接让他阅读 agents.md 即可，没必要维护两套。所有仓库都有类似的问题」

Program anchor: #17161 (the shape, the four-axis note and the known cost are recorded there once). 

## This repo

`CLAUDE.md` (41 lines on `origin/main`) restates four prime directives with their hooks. After this card it says one thing: `AGENTS.md` is the source of truth, read it before anything else — and nothing more (no rule, no hook roster, no digest). The hooks in `.claude/hooks/` keep enforcing worktree-first, the stash ban and the process-kill ban exactly as now; `AGENTS.md` already carries every rule the digest inlined (verify each of the four survives there by grep before deleting; a rule that does not survive is moved into `AGENTS.md`, not kept in `CLAUDE.md`).

`scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs` counts `CLAUDE.md` as one of two instruction surfaces that must name all five governed surfaces; a pointer file cannot, so the gate adapts in the same PR — a `CLAUDE.md` that is a pure pointer to `AGENTS.md` satisfies the check through its target — with the self-test case that pins it and a red case for a `CLAUDE.md` that carries prose but no pointer. ⛔ Not a weakening: the enforcement moves to the one file that carries the enumeration.

Governed (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**` untouched) ⇒ draft PR at the human terminal, `skip-changeset`. Serial: `CLAUDE.md` is free (no open PR touches it at filing).
